title: Open Rubric System: Scaling Reinforcement Learning with Pairwise Adaptive Rubric

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the JudgeBench benchmark and mitigated by conducting bidirectional pairwise comparisons (swapping the presentation order of candidate responses) to check for consistency.

Evaluated using RM-Bench and JudgeBench to test whether the reward model/judge is robust to style and length differences, ensuring it does not superficially favor longer, more verbose responses over substantively better short ones.
Evaluated using the JudgeBench benchmark to assess whether the LLM judge improperly favors responses that it generated itself.
